name: Classic Kill-Time Drop Percent Roll
description: Classic kill-time loot drops roll a uniform integer bucket from 1 through 100 and succeed when the roll is less than or equal to the stored drop percent.

algorithm.implementation_contract: floor(random()*100)+1 semantics; do not round scaled random values
algorithm.known_bad_pattern: (random()*99+1)::INT because PostgreSQL integer cast rounds and halves endpoint bucket width

affected_scope: all drop rows using kill-time percent resolution

evidence_refs.summary: Stored orc-head rates were correct at 1% common orcs and 3% captains, but the live roll-at-kill path used rounded PostgreSQL integer casting. The bug produced about 0.49% for 1% drops and 2.54% for 3% drops over 100k trials. Fix is floor(random()*100)+1.
